units.source_text: 话刚说完，警察也撇下我走了。

en.t: As soon as I finished speaking, the policeman left me behind and went away.

units.source_text: 我不得不反复念叨“刑法第一千二百八十五条”，赶紧到马咯家去。

en.t: I had no choice but to keep repeating “Article 1285 of the Criminal Code” as I hurried to Malo’s house.

units.source_text: 哲学家马咯是个非常好客的河童。

en.t: Malo the philosopher was a very hospitable kappa.

units.source_text: 幽暗的房间里，审判官培卟、医生查喀，玻璃公司经理嘎尔都在此呢，七彩玻璃灯笼下，烟雾缭绕。

en.t: In the dim room were Judge Pep, Doctor Chack, and even Gal, the manager of the glass company; beneath the seven-colored glass lantern, smoke hung thick in the air.

units.source_text: 审判官培卟在场，对我来说十分正好。

en.t: It was extremely convenient for me that Judge Pep was there.
